title: Satisfiability and Full Satisfaction
statement: Let a constraint satisfaction instance have a finite, nonempty domain and a finite variable set. The instance is satisfiable, meaning its maximum fraction of satisfied constraints is $1$, if and only if there is an assignment satisfying every constraint.
hypotheses_covered: The instance has a nonempty multiset of constraints
